tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID for Graph auth.

client_id.description: Microsoft Entra app registration client ID.

setup_mode.description: Teams setup mode. graph_channel uses Graph tokens and team/channel IDs; bot_framework uses Azure Bot credentials for Bot Framework ingress.

public_base_url.description: Public base URL for Graph notification callbacks.

team_id.description: Default team ID if not provided in invocation.

team_name.description: Human-readable display name for the selected team. Not used for routing.

channel_id.description: Default channel ID if not provided in invocation.

channel_name.description: Human-readable display name for the selected channel. Not used for routing.

desired_channel_name.description: Desired standard channel name for setup-time create-if-missing provisioning. The resulting channel_id remains authoritative.

chat_id.description: Default chat ID if not provided in invocation.

user_id.description: Default user ID for discovery or future DM flows.

client_secret.description: Optional confidential-client secret. Falls back to secrets store if omitted.

refresh_token.description: Optional Graph refresh token. Falls back to secrets store if omitted.

ms_bot_app_id.description: Azure Bot Framework app ID for bot_framework mode.

ms_bot_app_password.description: Azure Bot Framework app password for bot_framework mode.

bot_display_name.description: Human-readable Teams bot name for the Teams app manifest.

messaging_endpoint.description: Public Bot Framework messaging endpoint for Teams app manifests.
